content:
alex: FYI — ACME contacted support, saying their $500 trial credits never showed up in the workspace they use (acme-app). They have a second workspace (acme-app-1) created during SSO on-boarding. Looks like credits went to the wrong one.
maria: can you drop the org_id + both workspace_ids and the grant id if available? I can start the escalation.
alex: org_id: org_0a1b2c3d, primary_wid: ws_7890 (acme-app), other_wid: ws_7890-1 (acme-app-1). promo_grant: grant_2025_free500
samir: pulled the grant record. grant_2025_free500 -> applied_to: ws_7890-1, created_by_user: user_1145, applied_at: 2025-11-28T16:12:03Z. It looks like our promo flow attached the grant to the user's default workspace at time of accept, not the org's default workspace.
emma: I can repro locally. Flow is: user redeems promo via web flow -> we call POST /v1/grants with payer_user_id and workspace_id from client. If SSO onboarding creates a temporary workspace first, that wid gets stored. Snippet from local logs:

```
INFO grant.create payload: {"grant_id":"grant_2025_free500","user_id":"user_1145","workspace_id":"ws_7890-1","org_id":"org_0a1b2c3d","amount":500}
INFO grant.apply result: {"status":"applied","applied_to":"ws_7890-1"}
```
emma: root cause: client SDK sends the currently-active workspace id which can be the provisional one. We should prefer org_id-scoped grants or defer until org selection step.
maria: customer is upset, asking for immediate fix — can we move the credits to ws_7890 and confirm so they can resume testing? They need it today.
samir: I can do a manual transfer and log it. Running internal tool now:

```
> rbx billing transfer --from ws_7890-1 --to ws_7890 --grant grant_2025_free500 --note "CS manual transfer for ACME"
initiated transfer id: transfer_5501
```
billing-bot: Transfer initiated: transfer_5501. Owner: samir. Status: pending -> completed.
samir: transfer_5501 completed. Balance adjusted: ws_7890+500, ws_7890-1-500. I've added audit notes. Please confirm with customer.
maria: pinging ACME now. Replied: "Thanks — we see the credits, tests working. Appreciate the quick turnaround." :white_check_mark:
julie: please open an engineering ticket for fixing the promo flow. Priority P2 (customer hit + potential repeat). Assign to eng-infra/identity.
emma: filing ticket now: ENG-1258 - promo grant attaches to provisional workspace when SSO creates temp workspace; fix: use org_id when present or require explicit workspace selection before grant apply. I'll do a small canary patch and rollout next week.
maria: great. Also adding a one-off playbook for CS: how to check applied_to and perform `rbx billing transfer` for now. I'll add it to the CS internal runbook.
alex: closing loop with ACME, marking thread resolved. Thanks team.
